item.title: iPhone Duo is here! Excited to have worked on the design of our open/close transition. It’s designed to
item.author: @chan_k
item.description: iPhone Duo is here! Excited to have worked on the design of our open/close transition. It’s designed to make the two displays feel like one seamless experience by perceptually bending the focal plane, not the content, so that it feels like opening a window onto a singular view.

item.title: The latest project I’ve been working on is the design of Liquid Glass, alongside an army of designers
item.author: @chan_k
item.description: The latest project I’ve been working on is the design of Liquid Glass, alongside an army of designers and engineers. We're designing it to bend and shape light while feeling like an elastic, flexible material that can dynamically shape shift, to make apps feel fluid and organic.

item.title: The new project I designed arrives today - the Dynamic Island. Its goal is to feel like a
item.author: @chan_k
item.description:
The new project I designed arrives today - the Dynamic Island.

Its goal is to feel like a living, elastic bubble that can fluidly shape shift into different alerts and experiences.

This is just the start, but I’m excited to see it begin its life!

item.title: Excited to see full Drag and Drop come to iPhone, new in iOS 15. It works hand-in-hand with
item.author: @chan_k
item.description: Excited to see full Drag and Drop come to iPhone, new in iOS 15. It works hand-in-hand with the iPhone’s gestural interface, enabling some super fast ways to move things between apps.

item.author: @chan_k
